title: Neuroinflammation from ultrasound-driven blood-brain barrier modulation features early NFκB innate and late interferon immune stages
title_zh: 超声驱动血脑屏障调控引发的神经炎症表现早期NFκB先天免疫与晚期干扰素免疫阶段
abstract: Abstract Focused ultrasound with microbubbles noninvasively and transiently modulates the blood-brain barrier (BBB), enabling precise transvascular solute transport. This procedure minimizes edema and hemorrhage while avoiding long-term physiological and cognitive effects. Currently, this is in clinical trials for Alzheimer’s disease and brain cancers. As with any neurovascular insult, treatment may elicit a sterile inflammatory response (SIR), scaling with increasing mechanical index and microbubble dose. Most studies employ moderate parameters that induce Class II SIR with robust BBB modulation, with reports indicating acute immune activation within 5 min and up to 3 days post-treatment; however, longer-term dynamics remain unclear. Thus, we profiled murine brain transcriptomics for a week post-treatment. Integrative analyses identified a biphasic inflammatory response, characterized by an initial NFκB-driven peak at 3–6 h, followed by an interferon-mediated phase at 48 h that attenuates by a week. This finding reconciles prior inconsistencies, providing insights into establishing therapeutic windows and enhancing neuroinflammatory modulation strategies.
abstract_zh: 摘要：聚焦超声与微泡可无创、短暂地调节血脑屏障（BBB），实现精准的血管内溶质运输。该方法可降低水肿和出血风险，并避免长期生理与认知影响。目前已进入阿尔茨海默病和脑肿瘤的临床试验。与任何神经血管损伤一样，治疗可能诱发无菌炎症反应（SIR），其强度随机械指数和微泡剂量增加而升高。大多数研究采用中等参数，诱导II类SIR并实现稳健的BBB调节，报告显示治疗后5分钟内即出现急性免疫激活，持续至治疗后3天；但长期动力学尚不清楚。因此，我们在治疗后一周内对小鼠脑转录组进行分析。综合分析揭示双相炎症反应：3–6小时内出现NFκB驱动的峰值，随后在48小时出现干扰素介导的相位，至一周时逐渐减弱。该发现弥合了先前的矛盾，为确定治疗窗口和提升神经炎症调控策略提供了见解。
